encoding: All explicit text reads and writes used UTF-8; checks ran with python -X utf8.

reading_notes: voice-en.md was read again after a combined display was truncated; prose-en.md was then read separately in full.

The three check scripts were initially read in a combined call with truncated display, then relevant imports, file access and CLI lines were inspected separately. No extra data/reference file dependencies were found for Markdown inputs.
Persisted reports were read after each report had also been inspected in execution output.
The sole empirical evidence actually read was H1-materials.md; DOI and source metadata were supplied there and were not independently verified.
